# ZiiDi Trader

> A Kenyan stock, bond, and investment marketplace where buyers connect with sellers, complete trades via secure chat, and build a portfolio for resale and profit.

- [Home](/): Discover ZiiDi Trader — buy shares, sell at market gains, invest in bonds, and grow wealth with ZiiDi Lock and Auto Invest.
